name: After § 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text: 7a. Welcomes the EU Member States’ concrete contributions in this regard, such as the Italian ‘Falcone-Borsellino’ initiative, which is designed to help countries in Latin America and the Caribbean combat transnational organised crime, providing technical support and assistance, training and good practices in the fields of justice and security;
